objective: Continue the full CMS-V2 shadcn/ui refactor according to the Luna 6 plan while preserving institutional workflows.
changes: Migrated AlignmentSelectorDialog to shared Dialog, Button, Checkbox, Input, Label, and Badge primitives; fixed shrinking domain filters and mobile proposal badge wrapping, and made selected-count changes announce politely.
Added a Radix animation-settle step to the verification-loop skill after a live audit showed transient zoom transforms can produce false dialog bounds.

verification.tests: AlignmentSelectorDialog.test.jsx passed 7/7, covering modal accessibility, search/domain filters, saving selections, and the ten-item limit.
verification.lint_and_format: Scoped ESLint passed for the component and focused test. Prettier passed for the component, test, and visual audit script.
verification.build: Client production build passed with 4,853 modules transformed. Existing Tailwind arbitrary-ease ambiguity and large-chunk warnings remain.
verification.visual_evidence: Eight live /project/create captures cover discipline and SDG dialogs in light/dark at 1440x900 and 390x844. The captures were inspected; all dialogs fit their viewport, with no page overflow, Vite overlay, or application browser errors. Evidence is in scratch/qa-evidence/alignment-selector/.

workflow_safety: Used the user-provided reseed report only to sign in to a separate seeded student browser session. Credentials remained in process memory and were not printed or persisted. Opened and dismissed dialogs without saving proposals or changing account/project state.
